assertions.assertion: States that SAML signing requires an X.509 certificate
assertions.rationale: Opens by stating SAML signing requires an X.509 certificate, not a bare/raw key.

assertions.assertion: Explains that Automatic Key Management RSA keys are auto-wrapped into a self-signed X.509 container
assertions.rationale: Explains Automatic Key Management RSA keys are automatically wrapped into a self-signed X.509 container so SAML works out of the box.

assertions.assertion: States that AddDeveloperSigningCredential() (raw RSA) cannot be auto-wrapped and an X.509 cert with a private key is required instead
assertions.rationale: States AddDeveloperSigningCredential() produces a raw RSA key that cannot be auto-wrapped, and to register an X.509 certificate with a private key instead.

assertions.assertion: Notes that UseX509Certificate is not required just to enable SAML and is not supported for EC keys (custom ISamlSigningService needed)
assertions.rationale: Notes UseX509Certificate isn't needed merely to enable SAML and is not supported for EC keys, requiring a custom ISamlSigningService for EC.
